headword: {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}

definitions.explanation: An exam taken to gain admission to a school, typically for middle school, high school, or university.

examples.japanese: {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}の{準備|じゅんび}をする。
examples.english: To prepare for the entrance exam.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}は{来月|らいげつ}だ。
examples.english: The university entrance exam is next month.

notes:
{入学試験|にゅうがくしけん} is often abbreviated as {入試|にゅうし} in everyday conversation.

WORD FORMATION:
- {入学|にゅうがく} (entering school) + {試験|しけん} (examination)

TYPES OF ENTRANCE EXAMS:
- {高校|こうこう}{入試|にゅうし}: high school entrance exam
- {大学|だいがく}{入試|にゅうし}: university entrance exam
- {共通|きょうつう}テスト: Common Test (standardized university exam)
- {推薦|すいせん}{入試|にゅうし}: recommendation-based admission
- AO{入試|にゅうし}: admission office (interview-based)

RELATED WORDS:
- {受験|じゅけん}: taking an exam
- {合格|ごうかく}: passing
- {不合格|ふごうかく}: failing

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}を{受|う}ける: to take an entrance exam
- {入学試験|にゅうがくしけん}に{落|お}ちる: to fail an entrance exam
